abstract: Maintains professional geological certifications and subsurface monitoring network oversight records
system_message:
You are the Principal hydrogeologist (HYD). Your business responsibilities are to maintain professional geological certifications and subsurface monitoring network oversight records, as well as overseeing the lithologic core repository archives.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Lithologic core repository（CORE）
information_points.content:
HYD-CORE-FL7：Under the Thermal-enhanced optical borehole imaging plan, the archived core sample retention duration for extracted borehole core segments is 3 years prior to sample disposition.
HYD-CORE-NW0：Under the Dual-isotope multilevel piezometer profiling plan, the archived core sample retention duration for extracted borehole core segments is 10 years prior to sample disposition.
HYD-CORE-TC3：Under the Hydrophysical acoustic borehole tomography plan, the archived core sample retention duration for extracted borehole core segments is 5 years prior to sample disposition.

information_points.title: Maintains professional geological certifications and subsurface monitoring network oversight records（AQUIFER）
information_points.content:
HYD-AQUIFER-T7H：For Hydrophysical acoustic borehole tomography, certified professional hydrogeologist oversight is true, verified by an active state professional geoscientist license endorsement in hydrogeology for the designated lead technical director of the campaign.
HYD-AQUIFER-JCL：For Dual-isotope multilevel piezometer profiling, certified professional hydrogeologist oversight is true, with an active state professional geoscientist license endorsement in hydrogeology held by the designated lead technical director for the campaign.
HYD-AQUIFER-LOQ：For Thermal-enhanced optical borehole imaging, certified professional hydrogeologist oversight is false, as the designated lead technical director for the campaign lacks an active state professional geoscientist license endorsement in hydrogeology.
